context: First drive of the game. The defense is in its base 4-3.

options.reason: A steady run on first down is the safe way to start a drive. Even 4 yards makes second down easy.
A quick pass is fine on first down, but a run keeps the ball safe deep in your own end.
Deep shots take a long time and can be intercepted. From your own 25 on first down, that is a big gamble.
